svg.title: gadget32 on-device C++ path and PC fallback
svg.desc: C++ path on the ESP32-S3: JPEG in the browser is sent over HTTP to the ESP32-S3, decoded with JPEGDEC in PSRAM, resized to 240 by 240, dithered to a 6-color 4-bit frame, and sent over SPI to a Waveshare 1.54-inch E6 panel. A Python and Gradio path on a PC can pre-pack the same 28,800-byte frame.bin and upload it if you want to skip on-device decode.
